name: Raving Spirit

stealth.details: (expert) or DC 30 Perception check (master) to detect the spiritual nexus

disable: DC 30 Intimidation check (expert) to quiet the spirit for 1 round, or DC 32 Religion check (master) to exorcise it
reset: The haunt grows quiet and resets 1 minute after no creatures are in area B3.
routine: (2 actions) The haunts casts Phantasmal Killer (DC 30 Will save save and DC 30 Fortitude save save for critical failure) on a random creature who can see Currew's bed (it can even target creatures outside of area B3, so long as the target can see the bed). Everyone affected by the phantasmal killer sees the same image: a sickly old man lies in the bed, screaming and ranting about his guilt, shame, and eventual death.

items.name: Raving Diatribe
items.text:
Trigger A creature remains in area B3 for longer than 1 round

---

Effect Each creature in the sealed room is targeted by Nightmare (DC 30 Will save save). The haunt counts as having met the targets. It then rolls initiative.

text: The restless spirit of Currew raves against his tormentors when someone enters his room.
